task: Pin narwhal-portal to the release containing the GitOps liveness and readiness routes (Narwhal#238)

events.summary: Issue #238 identifies a GitOps image and probe-path seam plus an airgap version drift; changes stay within portal pins, regression checks, lessons, and evidence.
Clean install on 2026-09-28: narwhal-portal readiness probe to /api/health/ready returned HTTP 404 and the liveness probe failed, restarting the pod; the pinned v1.0.17 tree predates both routes.
evidence: runtime:clean-install readiness probe HTTP 404 /api/health/ready; liveness probe failure and CrashLoopBackOff

events.summary: Updated every active portal image reference to 1.0.18, aligned the airgap OCI index digest, and added R210/R211 pin and route-tree regression checks. Recorded that the release is unsigned; no signing or policy change was made.
R210 requires one shared active pin version; R211 inspects v<version> for both Next.js route files when the sibling checkout exists and clearly skips when absent.
evidence: test:mutation R210 mixed portal versions rejected
test:mutation R211 v1.0.17 rejected for missing probe routes
